## ✅ Applied Fixes (Phase 1 — One-Shot Unified Patching)

### Fix 1 — `backend/core/admin_routes.py` — 🔴 CRITICAL Auth Bypass

- **Flaw:** `GET/POST /admin/rules` had zero authentication. Anyone could read or overwrite the rules engine.
- **Fix:** Added `get_current_admin()` dependency function (importing `get_current_user_token` from `api.dependencies`) and enforced it on both `GET /admin/rules` and `POST /admin/rules` endpoints.

### Fix 11 — `backend/core/llm/token_deductor.py` — 🔴 CRITICAL Redis Lock Bypass

- **Flaw:** Redis lock fallback `return True` when `redis_queue.configured` is False allowed double-spending.
- **Fix:** Added Fail-Closed mode - raises `RuntimeError` in production/staging when Redis unavailable.

### Fix 12 — `backend/core/immune_system.py` — 🔴 CRITICAL AST Bypass

- **Flaw:** `getattr()`, `hasattr()` can be used to bypass sandbox via `__class__.__bases__[0].__subclasses__()`.
- **Fix:** Enhanced `visit_Call()` to block reflection function calls, added chained subscript/dunder validation.

### Fix 13 — `backend/core/sentinel_agent.py` — 🔴 CRITICAL SSRF

- **Flaw:** `ApiEndpoint.path` used without URL validation allows metadata IP access.
- **Fix:** Added `_validate_endpoint_url()` method that blocks dangerous schemes (file, gopher) and metadata IPs (169.254.x.x, 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x).

### Fix 14 — `backend/core/cache/redis_manager.py` — HIGH Lock Hijack

- **Flaw:** `release_idempotency_lock()` used simple `DEL` allowing lock hijacking.
- **Fix:** Added Lua script `_RELEASE_LUA` for atomic owner-verified lock release.

### Fix 15 — `backend/core/rate_limiter.py` — MEDIUM Rate Limit

- **Flaw:** In-memory fallback doesn't work across multiple Cloud Run instances.
- **Fix:** Changed to Fail-Closed - raises `RuntimeError` when Redis unavailable.

### Fix 16 — `backend/core/llm/token_deductor.py` — MEDIUM Precision

- **Flaw:** Floating-point arithmetic `cost_float` causes precision loss.
- **Fix:** Changed to pure Decimal arithmetic with `quantize(Decimal("0.000001"))`.

### Fix 17 — `backend/api/routes/billing_api.py` — MEDIUM Stack Trace

- **Flaw:** `detail=str(e)` exposed internal error details to client.
- **Fix:** Changed to generic error message "Payment processing error. Please contact support."

### Fix 18 — `backend/sandbox/docker_sandbox.py` — LOW Script Injection

- **Flaw:** `entry_file.replace('.py', '')` allows shell injection.
- **Fix:** Added `_sanitize_module_name()` to strictly allow only alphanumeric/underscore characters.
